description: The pie chart represents the distribution of three different types of answer formats in a dataset: True-False, Multiple-Choice, and Open-Answer questions. The chart is divided into three slices, each representing one of the answer types. The True-False questions, which are the smallest slice, make up 4.1% of the total and are represented by a blue color. The Multiple-Choice questions, which are the second largest slice, account for 32.8% and are shown in orange. The Open-Answer questions, which constitute the majority of the chart, make up 63.0% and are depicted in green. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
